description: This file defines the QualificationLanguageController class within the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up a Vue component for the qualification language list during the pre-render phase.

classes.name: QualificationLanguageController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling the qualification language list view within the HRM admin plugin. It prepares the Vue component for rendering.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to set up the Vue component 'qualification-language-list' before rendering.
